digest.component_or_area: cascade table and parent-child lifecycle enforcement
propositions: The _CASCADING_EDGES table's one-eligible-status-per-edge shape allows two reachable residuals that do not cascade: reactivating a closed child under an open parent, and blocked→in_progress resume under an open parent.

The store must maintain the invariant that no non-terminal-state ticket can be a child of a closed ticket, enforced jointly by the cascade table's closed-source rows and the unconditional open-children close guard.
The §I4a headline 'A child never runs ahead of its parent' overstates the guarantee; it must be narrowed to the per-edge, same-edge guarantee the enumerated table actually provides.

The blocked→in_progress resume disagreement between the start-work gate (which fires on that edge) and the cascade table (which omits it) must be resolved as documented non-cascading, with reconciliation between gate and cascade behavior in table/docs.
No transition refused today becomes permitted; the claim-status guard and table rows remain unchanged; only documentation, comments, and tests are modified.
